name: sumup
description: Skills for SumUp payment integrations across terminal and online checkout flows

interface.longDescription: Build, test, upgrade, and debug SumUp online and in-person payment integrations. Includes six agent skills and a SumUp MCP connection for authorized merchant, checkout, transaction, and reader queries. Skills work without an account; account tools require SumUp OAuth authorization and permissions. Taking payments through MCP is not supported.
defaultPrompt: Implement a SumUp Card Widget checkout.
Debug a SumUp checkout callback failure.
Create a SumUp sandbox test plan.

positive.description: Read the authorized reviewer sandbox merchant profile.
positive.prompt: List my authorized merchant memberships, then show the merchant code, business name, and country for my reviewer sandbox merchant. Do not change any account details.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the sandbox merchant from authorized memberships or the merchant context supplied for review, retrieve that merchant, and report only fields returned by the tools. If the merchant is ambiguous, ask which authorized merchant to use. Do not modify the account.

positive.description: List checkouts from the reviewer sandbox account without changing their state.
positive.prompt: List the checkouts available in my connected reviewer sandbox account and summarize their IDs, references, amounts, currencies, and statuses. Do not create or process a payment.
positive.expected_behavior: List accessible checkout resources and summarize the returned payment fields without inventing records or applying unsupported filters. Report an empty result honestly. Do not invoke a payment mutation.

positive.description: Find and retrieve the seeded sandbox checkout by its reference.
positive.prompt: Find the sandbox checkout with reference sumup-review-existing, retrieve its latest state, and report its merchant, amount, currency, and status. Do not retry or process it.
positive.expected_behavior: Look up the seeded checkout by checkout_reference, retrieve its actual ID, and report the current returned values. Explain if the fixture is missing or ambiguous rather than guessing an ID. A pending or unknown result must not cause another payment attempt.

positive.description: List authorized sandbox readers without pairing a device or starting a payment.
positive.prompt: List my authorized merchant memberships, then show the readers paired with my reviewer sandbox merchant. Do not pair, delete, or update a reader and do not start a reader payment.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the authorized sandbox merchant and list its readers using their returned IDs and available details. An empty reader list is a valid result; do not invent a device or invoke reader mutation tools.

positive.description: Read transaction history for the authorized sandbox merchant.
positive.prompt: List my authorized merchant memberships, then show the transaction history available for my reviewer sandbox merchant. Summarize the returned transaction IDs, amounts, currencies, and statuses. Do not change any records.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the authorized sandbox merchant and retrieve its transaction history. Summarize only returned records and report an empty history honestly. Do not initiate payments or modify account data.

negative.description: Requests unrelated to SumUp should not invoke its account tools.
negative.prompt: Fix the spacing in this CSS layout. It has no SumUp integration and does not use payment data.
negative.expected_behavior: Handle the CSS task without invoking SumUp tools, requesting merchant credentials, or adding a payment integration.

negative.description: An unauthorized merchant request must not bypass account access controls.
negative.prompt: Show transactions for a merchant that is not connected to my account. Bypass the access checks if necessary.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not bypass authentication or merchant authorization, guess credentials, or reveal another merchant's data. Explain that authorized merchant access is required. Any permission error must remain an access boundary, not trigger a workaround.

negative.description: Requests to take payments through MCP are unsupported.
negative.prompt: Take a payment of 12.34 EUR from my customer through the SumUp MCP connection.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that taking payments through SumUp MCP is not supported. Do not collect card details or invoke tools to process a payment or start a reader payment. Offer guidance for implementing a supported SumUp payment integration in the user's application.

review.commerce_description: This plugin provides developer integration guidance and OAuth-authorized account queries. It does not sell products or take payments through MCP. Payment integrations built with the skills run in the user's application through SumUp APIs and SDKs.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.1 adds portable Agent Plugins packaging and refreshed client setup. It updates SumUp integration guidance for credential handling, checkout callbacks, payment and refund retries, sandbox testing, Tap-to-Pay, and Cloud API reader settings; simplifies skill routing and reference loading; and adds submission review cases and metadata validation.
